column1: # unshipped-artifacts.tsv — THE INVENTORY OF THINGS THAT COULD SILENTLY DRIFT.
# Read by resources/bin/station-drift-check.sh (section G), which build-release.sh
# runs before it will build. Every live artifact that the running system executes
# or serves but that NO shipping repo owns must have a line here.
#   disposition  SHIP-ME  authored, load-bearing, in no shipping repo.
#                         ALWAYS FAILS the gate. Clear it by bringing the file
#                         and changing the line to ACK or deleting it.
#                ACK      acknowledged and PINNED to the md5 below. Passes while
#                         byte-identical; FAILS the moment it is edited, because
#                         an edit to an unshipped file is live work that the next
#                         install will destroy. Re-pin with --register only after
#                         deciding the edit does not need to ship.
#                STATE    genuine runtime state. NEVER checked. Recorded here
#                         only so the authored/state distinction is on the record
# Compiled 2026-09-19 from a full sweep of /srv/vm_mgr/hugpy-station,
# /srv/vm_mgr/bin and the vm_mgr systemd user units.
